concerns.text: The specification never defines a justified, data‑driven labeling scheme for the target variable ‘phase‑change‑suitable’. It implicitly relies on a hard‑coded latent‑heat threshold (> 150 J/g) (as noted in the prior unresolved concern) without providing any justification, sensitivity analysis, or handling of class imbalance. Training and evaluating models on an arbitrarily defined binary label introduces bias and makes the validation of governing factors circular, undermining the scientific validity of the study.
